title: Court aid.
bodyText: Each county fire chief or the state fire marshal may invoke the aid of any court of competent jurisdiction to enforce any order or action made or taken by the fire chief or state fire marshal in pursuance of law.
bodyHtml: §132-12  Court aid.  Each county fire chief or the state fire marshal may invoke the aid of any court of competent jurisdiction to enforce any order or action made or taken by the fire chief or state fire marshal in pursuance of law. [L 1917, c 115, pt of §49; RL 1925, pt of §3463; RL 1935, pt of §6839; am L 1939, c 239, §1(20); RL 1945, §8537; RL 1955, §184-14; am L 1965, c 96, §127; HRS §132-14; ren and am L 1978, c 241, §2(15); gen ch 1985; am L 1993, c 6, §7; am L 2025, c 302, §13]
